description: This file defines the internal class StreamConsumer<T> which manages stream subscriptions, including subscribing, resuming, unsubscribing, and cleanup operations within the Orleans streaming framework. It handles interaction with pub/sub components, manages extension binding, and provides detailed logging.

classes.name: StreamConsumer<T>
classes.description: An internal class implementing IInternalAsyncObservable<T> that manages stream subscription lifecycle, including subscribing, resuming, unsubscribing, and cleanup, with integration to pub/sub and extension mechanisms.

methods.name: SubscribeAsync
methods.description: Initiates a subscription with an observer or batch observer, optionally with a sequence token and filter data.

methods.name: SubscribeAsyncImpl
methods.description: Core implementation for subscribing, handling registration with pub/sub and extension setup.

methods.name: ResumeAsync
methods.description: Resumes a subscription from a handle with a new observer or batch observer.

methods.name: ResumeAsyncImpl
methods.description: Core implementation for resuming a subscription, updating the extension with the new observer.

methods.name: UnsubscribeAsync
methods.description: Unsubscribes from a stream, unregistering from pub/sub and removing extension observers.

methods.name: GetAllSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all current subscriptions for the stream.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up all stream handles and unregisters consumers from pub/sub.

methods.name: InternalRemoveObserver
methods.description: Used in testing to remove an observer internally.

methods.name: DiagGetConsumerObserversCount
methods.description: Returns a diagnostic count of stream observers.

methods.name: BindExtensionLazy
methods.description: Lazily binds the extension and grain reference, ensuring thread safety.

methods.name: CheckHandleValidity
methods.description: Validates a subscription handle for correctness and validity.
